dashboard.greetingSummary: Here's a reassuring summary of your children's progress this week.

recommendation.label: Recommendation
recommendation.noChildrenBody: Connect an account using the code from the teacher to see progress in real time.
recommendation.noActivityBody: Encourage your children to explore the library — the first activities will appear here right away.
recommendation.pauseBody: No recent activity recorded. A short session today can keep the learning rhythm going.
recommendation.supportBody: The average score is {{score}}%. See which games are worth repeating together.
recommendation.goodPaceBody: Children are progressing steadily. Keep encouraging short and frequent sessions.

emptyState.label: No children connected
emptyState.title: Connect your first child to see their progress
emptyState.body: Use the invite code from your child's teacher. In a few seconds you'll see completed games, scores, and useful recommendations.

familyShell.heading: Family Home
familyShell.summary: Follow your children in a simple feed, similar to class messages.

empty.noneBody: Teacher posts and finished games will appear here in the order they happen.
empty.childBody: This will appear as soon as a teacher posts work or the child finishes a game.

feed.unavailablePhoto: Work is not available right now.

feed.unavailableVideo: Video is not available right now.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.noNotificationsBody: You'll receive notifications here when your child gets new assignments or reaches important milestones.
